description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2014 World Championships by shutting the opponent down: Accelgor's Deck and Cover Poisons and Paralyzes, then shuffles Accelgor away so Trevenant can step in and stop Item cards, while Dusknoir moves damage counters to pick which Pokémon to Knock Out. The 2014 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., from 15 to 17 August 2014.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2014 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
